name: PROSP
description: LinkedIn outreach automation with AI personalization (prosp.ai); listed for sale on TrustMRR.

mentions.evidence: ~$128.0k MRR, 1,108 active subscriptions, ~$98.5k L30, ~$507k all-time. Stripe key expired; data last updated Feb 5, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Outbound tooling still prints; the moat is account warm-up / proxy ops, not the LLM copy.

whyItPrints: Agencies and sales teams already pay for LinkedIn volume. Residential proxies + sequences is an old play that still clears Stripe.
whyThisMatters:
Sales teams and agencies use PROSP for LinkedIn outreach that reads like one person wrote it. It looks at the prospect's profile and what they've been doing lately, then drafts a one-to-one message and a voice note in your voice. Recruiters use it. So do go-to-market teams.

You set up sequences and pull leads in. Replies land in a single inbox. You can tag a thread, filter by campaign, and see who actually wrote back. Users talk about stacking messages closer together than the long pause most tools force, and about grabbing contacts straight off LinkedIn. Setup takes about five minutes. You can cancel when you want. The promise on the account side is that your LinkedIn stays safe. Capterra has it at five out of five.

Residential proxies sit under those sequences, which is how the volume goes out without cooking the account. The company is up for sale. Stripe access lapsed in February 2026, so the monthly number from then is a snapshot. What you're paying for is the reply. A note, plus a voice message, that doesn't look like a blast.
